text.autoconfig.quest_api.option.finish_: Spawn a colorful firework burst on the player when they claim quest rewards.
text.autoconfig.quest_api.option.hit_coo: Hitting a quest giver cancels quests
Attacking a quest giver cancels your active quest with them and puts them on an interaction cooldown.
How many minutes a quest giver refuses interaction after being hit.
text.autoconfig.quest_api.option.hud_mes: Show short fading HUD messages above the hotbar for quest events instead of posting them in chat.
text.autoconfig.quest_api.option.quest_d: Reveal a quest's description one character at a time the first time its detail pane is opened in a client session.
Milliseconds per revealed character for the quest description typewriter effect.
text.autoconfig.quest_api.option.show_al: Show all quest tiers in the list at once, with locked ones marked. Off = reveal each tier as you complete the previous one.
text.autoconfig.quest_api.option.show_qu: Show the quest giver's coordinates in the Active Quests screen. Always shown in creative mode regardless of this setting.
text.autoconfig.quest_api.option.village: Villager trade XP on quest claim
Villagers gain trading-level experience when a player claims quest rewards from them.
Trading XP granted per quest tier on claim (tier * this value).
